about.privacy: No account, no telemetry. Loads the mod list from tm-horizon.com (your IP is visible to the server).
about.privacyHosts: Contacted only when you use them: GitHub, Exchange sites, ManiaPark, Openplanet, TMLoader mod servers, Steam/IGDB covers, Nadeo downloads, game servers in your list. They see your IP.
about.trademark: Not affiliated with Ubisoft or Nadeo. TrackMania is a trademark of Ubisoft.
host.testFriend: Test: a friend joins with your IP and port {port}.
host.upnpFallback: The server tries UPnP itself. Otherwise open the ports in the router.
host.firewallMissing: Rules missing: not reachable from outside until Allow.
inst.src.gamesTip: Found in a Games folder (home, Documents or a drive root).
